zh.title: 漢光42號演習首日 陸戰隊搭CH-47SD直升機北上防護中樞
zh.summary: 國軍漢光42號實兵演習於8月5日展開。首日演練中，海軍陸戰隊官兵兵分兩路增援，除陸路長程機動外，部分官兵搭乘2架CH-47SD直升機飛抵台北附近降落，執行中樞防護演練。此外，海軍濱海作戰大隊中午亦於高雄出動機動飛彈車組，開赴指定位置實施待命放列部署。
body: 國軍漢光42號實兵演習於2026年8月5日正式展開，進行為期10天9夜的實兵操演。在演習首日，為驗證關鍵防區的快速反應能力，海軍陸戰隊官兵依循日前的操演模式，採取兵分兩路的方式北上進行增援。除主要兵力自高雄林園駐地出發、透過陸路長程機動北上之外，部分官兵則搭乘2架CH-47SD契努克運兵直升機，執行長程空中機動任務。
根據現場拍攝與相關消息，這2架CH-47SD直升機編隊直接飛抵台北一帶降落。此次演練著重於政經中樞遭到突發威脅時，海軍陸戰隊官兵如何即時投入戰場，以有效反制敵方的空降或滲透行為，進而確保整體戰略縱深的防禦安全。除了陸戰隊之外，演習首日亦有其他相關單位循相同空中機動模式進行增援。
與此同時，海軍「濱海作戰大隊」亦於5日中午在高雄地區出動機動飛彈車組。當日中午12時21分許，共有4輛飛彈發射車、1輛射控指管車及各式附屬車輛，在完成整補整備後，依序駛出高雄市左營區的海軍左營基地大門，出發前往指定的戰術位置實施放列與部署。據了解，這些機動車組將在抵達戰力保存位置後待命，並依後續戰略命令採取行動。
此次演習自8月5日起實施至14日止。在衡山指揮所於清晨下達演習命令後，各軍種均展開全面戰備部署，以防範敵軍「由演轉戰」。除了海軍各式艦艇緊急出港前往指定疏泊區、海軍機動雷達與飛彈車組實施機動外，空軍各型戰機也進行戰備轉場以保存戰力，防空部隊全面部署，陸軍亦同步實施重要目標防護與阻絕架設演練。

en.title: Han Kuang Drills Begin with Marines Deploying via CH-47SD Helicopters
en.summary: The Han Kuang 42 live-troop military exercise commenced on August 5, 2026, for a ten-day period. On the first day of the drills, Taiwan's Marine Corps conducted reinforcement operations using both land and air routes. Specifically, some marines boarded two CH-47SD Chinook transport helicopters and landed near Taipei to perform critical political and economic center protection drills. Simultaneously, the Navy's Coastal Combat Force deployed mobile missile launcher vehicles and control trucks from Tsoying Base in Kaohsiung to tactical positions, enhancing rapid response readiness.
body: The Han Kuang 42 live-troop military exercise commenced on August 5, 2026, and is scheduled to run for ten days and nine nights until August 14. To verify the rapid reaction capabilities of critical defense zones, Taiwan's Marine Corps conducted reinforcement operations on the first day of the drills, dividing their forces into land and air routes to move north. While the primary forces executed long-distance overland maneuvers from their station in Linyuan, Kaohsiung, other troops boarded two CH-47SD Chinook transport helicopters for a long-distance aerial mobilization.

According to reports from the field, the two CH-47SD transport helicopters flew in formation and landed directly in the Taipei area. The deployment focused on simulating immediate battlefield intervention by the Marine Corps during sudden threats to the political and economic center. The drill aimed to counter simulated enemy airborne drops or infiltration, securing strategic defense depth. Other military units also followed similar aerial mobilization patterns to reinforce key positions during the first day of the exercise.

Simultaneously, the Navy's Coastal Combat Force deployed mobile missile vehicle units in Kaohsiung around noon on August 5. At approximately 12:21 PM, four missile launcher trucks, one fire control command vehicle, and various support vehicles departed from the main gate of the Tsoying Naval Base in Kaohsiung's Tsoying District after completing preparation. These mobile units traveled to designated tactical positions to await subsequent strategic orders while preserving combat capabilities.

Following the early morning commands issued by the Hengshan Military Command Center, comprehensive combat deployments were initiated across all service branches. In addition to the naval and marine movements, naval vessels completed emergency preparations and left ports for designated anchorage areas. Air Force fighter jets executed tactical transfers to preserve combat capabilities, air defense forces deployed fully, and the Army set up defensive barriers and protected key installations to guard against potential sudden escalation.

zh.title: 國防部表示若順利明年將完成數套反無人機系統
zh.summary: 國防部戰略規劃司長黃文啓中將5日指出，台灣無人機及反制系統起步較晚，目前依現有情監偵系統掌握，若順利明年將完成數套反無人機系統。同時國防部通次室與資通電軍對反無人機頻譜分割已有詳細規劃。
body: 國防部戰略規劃司長黃文啓中將5日在立法院答詢時表示，台灣在無人機與反制系統發展上起步較晚，目前主要利用現有的情監偵系統掌握無人機動態。若相關作業推動順利，預計明年將完成數套反無人機系統。
黃文啓說明，國防部通訊電子資訊參謀次長室以及資通電軍，對於反無人機作戰中的頻譜分割問題已具備詳細規劃。國防部作戰及計畫參謀次長侯嘉倫中將則補充，目前國軍針對蜂群無人機主要以現有裝備進行應對。
此外，漢光42號實兵演習自8月5日起展開，規劃進行10天9夜。無人機攻防與各項防衛作戰演練為本次演習重點之一。

en.title: Taiwan Defense Ministry Plans Counter-Drone Systems Completion Next Year
en.summary: Taiwan Ministry of National Defense Strategic Planning Department Director Major General Huang Wen-chi stated on August 5 that Taiwan started late in developing drones and counter-drone systems. Huang noted that if progress proceeds smoothly, several counter-drone systems are expected to be completed next year. Currently, drones are monitored through existing reconnaissance systems. In addition, the ministry's Communications, Electronics and Information Bureau and the Information and Electronic Warfare Command have developed detailed plans regarding spectrum allocation for counter-drone operations, while existing military equipment is utilized to address potential drone swarms.
body: Speaking at the Legislative Yuan on August 5, Major General Huang Wen-chi, Director of the Strategic Planning Department of the Ministry of National Defense, stated that Taiwan started late in developing drones and counter-drone systems. He noted that if progress proceeds smoothly, several counter-drone systems will be completed next year.

Huang added that the ministry's Communications, Electronics and Information Bureau and the Information and Electronic Warfare Command have established detailed planning for spectrum allocation during counter-drone operations. Meanwhile, Major General Hou Jia-lun, Director of Operations and Planning, stated that current military equipment is being used to handle potential drone swarms.
The Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise officially began on August 5 for a ten-day and nine-night schedule, with drone offense and defense featured as key elements of the drills.
